svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Languages: Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL. AI and vision: PyTorch, TensorRT, ONNX, OpenCV, NumPy, pandas. Embedded and IoT: ESP32, ESP32-S3, Jetson Nano, Arduino, ATECC608B, MQTT. Web and apps: React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js and Express, FastAPI, REST. Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, Supabase. Tools: Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Postman, Jest, Linux. Design: Adobe Illustrator, Substance 3D Modeler, Painter, Designer, Sampler and Stager.
